sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks. Pro
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Installs TeraBox as a separate app alongside the original, with its own account. Each copy needs a different clone number.
Restores signing in with a Google account.
Removes feed, banner, interstitial, app-open, video player and rewarded ads. Features unlocked by watching an ad are unavailable.
Hides the ad consent form shown at startup.
Hides Premium upgrade cards and banners, prize and campaign cards, speed-up prompts, floating invites, and sale, coupon and promotional popups.
Hides the recommended videos below the video player.
Unlocks HD up to original quality, playback speeds up to 3x and video uploads. HD buffers faster over parallel connections.
